threat_visualizer.summary:
The device server01.example.local was observed initiating repeated connections over port 443 to the external IP 203.0.113.50.

Such beaconing activity is sometimes attributable to unwanted or potentially malicious software communicating with external command and control servers.

If this behaviour is unexpected, further investigation may be required to determine if this activity represents malicious command and control or legitimate telemetry of some form.
